description: This file defines the `FlowAnalysisContext` case class used for evaluating a Flow's query within Spark SQL pipelines. It manages input identifiers, Spark session configurations, and analysis warnings during query evaluation.

classes.name: FlowAnalysisContext
classes.description: A context used when evaluating a Flow's query into a concrete DataFrame, managing inputs, Spark configurations, and warnings.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Sets a Spark configuration key-value pair within the context, saving the original value to restore later.

methods.name: restoreOriginalConf
methods.description: Restores Spark configurations to their original state before modifications in this context.
